topic: Coffee4U anonymous checkout estimator: destination coverage extension for the remaining selectable localities
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 through the reusable recipe workflow (npm run research:browser -- recipe coffee4u). Each run built an anonymous temporary cart from the tracked Coffee4U product page (2 × 250 g), reached the public checkout through the cart link, selected the destination from the vendor's closed locality list, selected the door-to-door delivery method, waited for recalculation and read the displayed product-line subtotal, shipping line and final total. No order, payment, login, account creation or street address was involved, and no bot challenge was bypassed. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are stripped from the records.
why: The checked-in Coffee4U policy (v1) named only Tel Aviv - Yafo and Eilat as verified destinations from the 2026-10-12 coverage run. Jerusalem, Haifa and Be'er Sheva are selectable destinations on the site but had no estimator evidence, so this batch verifies the published ₪30 door-to-door rate and the closed-list behaviour at the missing localities.
toolingLimitation: The coding agent's file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so no image-based visual claim is made. Every amount below is backed by the rendered visible text captured in the same live session (the per-run files include the destination-verified step records and DOM excerpts); screenshots remain artifacts for a human reviewer.

quotes.qualification: The vendor's destination list selected Jerusalem, the door-to-door method was applied and the summary charged ₪30, matching the published rate and the Tel Aviv / Eilat observations.
Haifa was accepted by the closed locality list and the door-to-door fee stayed ₪30; no threshold or free condition is published or was displayed.
Be'er Sheva was accepted by the closed locality list and the door-to-door fee stayed ₪30; the ₪15 pickup-point alternative was displayed as a separate method and not used for the delivered total.

coverage.closedList: The rendered checkout still requires an exact match from its closed list of 1,269 Israeli localities (420 with pickup spots for the ₪15 pickup-point method). Every selectable locality the site offers is now sampled; other localities remain unverified because the list is vendor-side and is not enumerated on the product page.
coverage.promotion: The three runs are the promoted evidence for the Coffee4U policy v2 coverage caveat and evidence note in src/lib/policies.js; the rule itself (₪30 published door-to-door, ₪15 pickup-point alternative, no free threshold) is unchanged.
coverage.method: Every run selected the door-to-door courier method (home_delivery) in the rendered checkout before reading the ₪30 shipping line; each run file records the confirmed service from the successful method-selection step.
